g.text: Frozen 30 | ranked = hard_exchange_edit4; placebo = uniform old candidate, same 4x gate/victim

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #50616e

g.text: Both placebo streams are separate 30-request executions; never pooled. IBS/OBS use the original fixed-window gate and original seeds: context only, not paired.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #50616e

g.text: TPF = mean request N/F; physical efficiency = sum(N)/sum(physical Q); failed/truncated retained.
